key_insight: A three-stage random forest pipeline can forecast whether Medicare reimbursement rates will change, which direction they will move, and by how much using only historical fee-schedule data.
clinical_relevance: More accurate reimbursement forecasting could help imaging and hospital operations teams anticipate financial risk and plan service delivery and staffing.
method: Trained on four CMS fee schedules: CLFS, PFS, AFS, and DMEPOS
Used lag-1 features and train-only preprocessing to avoid leakage
Validated with chronological out-of-time testing and label-shuffling permutation checks
evidence_signal: The model achieved concordance indices of 0.815-0.998 overall, reduced MAE by 29%-85%, and showed no leakage signal in shuffled-label tests (AUC 0.467-0.515).
watch_item: Performance dropped outside the training period for the PFS, so the model may be less reliable when Medicare policy shifts materially over time.
paper_title: A Multi-Schedule Machine Learning Pipeline for Medicare Reimbursement Change Prediction and Operational Risk Stratification
